items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Tony and I were playing five years together... Tony was my best man at my wedding... I was one of Tony's pallbearers.

ctx.x: That's... You mean in the sense of playing like white musicians or in the sense of... Oh, sure. Yeah. Well, I think they're getting around to appreciating people. Fusier Wright was responsible for a lot of that somehow. They began to appreciate him. He was the one that they sort of fell in love with.
